metadata.title: CASMI 2026 Spectral Library (MassBank,harmonized)
metadata.description:
# CASMI 2026 Reference Spectral Library (MassBank, harmonized)

**Built for:** [Enveda CASMI 2026 — Molecule ID From Mass Spectra](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/enveda-CASMI26-molecule-id-mass-spectra)

A cleaned, standardized, ML-ready version of the public **MassBank** MS/MS spectral
library — the reference library most structure-elucidation baselines (spectral
matching, retrieval, candidate reranking) need and nobody had packaged for this
competition yet.

## What's inside

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `spectra.parquet` | 139,744 MS/MS spectra: precursor m/z, adduct, ion mode, collision energy, retention time (where available), full peak lists (`mzs`, `intensities`), and full source attribution per record |
| `structures_with_fingerprints.parquet` | 20,204 unique structures (by InChIKey): canonical SMILES, molecular formula, exact mass, **precomputed Morgan (1024-bit ECFP4) and MACCS fingerprints** (hex-packed bit vectors) for fast candidate retrieval/similarity search |
| `spectra_preview.csv` | First 2,000 spectra (metadata only, no peak arrays) for quick browsing |

## Why this matters for CASMI 2026

The competition task is: given an MS/MS spectrum, predict the 2D structure
(SMILES). Every retrieval-based or reranking approach needs:
1. A reference library of **known spectrum → structure pairs** to match against.
2. **Precomputed molecular fingerprints** for fast candidate similarity scoring.

This dataset gives you both, already harmonized into one schema, so you don't
have to write a MassBank parser yourself.

Bonus: **648 spectra are from the actual CASMI 2012 and CASMI 2016 challenge
subsets** within MassBank — directly relevant historical structure-elucidation
benchmark data, flagged via `is_casmi_subset=True`.

## Coverage

- 139,744 spectra across 61 contributing institutions (Eawag, RIKEN, BAFG, University of Tokyo, and more)
- 20,204 unique structures
- Positive (98k) and negative (41k) ion mode
- Precursor m/z range: 46 – 2465
- ~104k spectra include retention time

## Provenance & licensing — read before using

This is a derivative compilation of public **MassBank** records
(https://github.com/MassBank/MassBank-data), which aggregates contributions
from many labs under **mixed Creative Commons licenses** (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA,
CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA). The **license for every individual spectrum is preserved**
in the `license` column, along with `authors`, `publication`, and `copyright`
where the original record provided them — **check the per-record license
before using a given spectrum outside a research/competition context**, since
many are non-commercial only.

Records originally licensed **CC-*-ND (No Derivatives)** were excluded
entirely (149 records) since a reformatted derivative dataset cannot legally
be redistributed under that license.

This dataset itself is shared for **research and competition use**, matching
the most common upstream license terms (CC BY-NC-SA). If you use it, please
also credit the original MassBank contributing institutions listed in the
`source_institution` / `authors` columns of the record(s) you rely on.

## Build pipeline (reproducible)

1. Clone `MassBank/MassBank-data` (public GitHub repo, ~141k records).
2. Parse each MassBank flat-file record into structured fields (compound,
   spectrum metadata, peak list).
3. Canonicalize SMILES and derive InChIKey with RDKit; drop unparseable
   structures.
4. Drop ND-licensed records.
5. Deduplicate structures by InChIKey; compute Morgan(2,1024) and MACCS
   fingerprints per unique structure.
6. Export to Parquet.

## Suggested uses

- Baseline: cosine/modified-cosine spectral similarity search against this
  library to retrieve candidate structures for a query spectrum.
- Fingerprint-based candidate reranking once you have a shortlist from mass/formula filtering.
- Training data / pretraining signal for spectrum embedding models.
- Benchmarking against the embedded CASMI 2012/2016 subset.
